organization_and_why.profile_excerpt: County-wide food bank operating a 40,000 square foot warehouse. Racked warehouse with temperature-controlled bays and a monitored freezer. Dock-height receiving, and we can send a reefer for anything that needs the cold chain.

whose_neighborhood.tract: Nearest census tract: 13% of residents below the poverty line, 54% of households without a vehicle, 0% on food or cash assistance (ACS; recipient location is ZIP-level, so this is the area, not the exact block).

outreach_message:
Hello Feeding America team,

a distributor in Chicago has 48 cases of infant formula. It is still good but has to move soon. From what we have on file you have the storage for it. The food needs to leave by about 5760 hours from now, which leaves you roughly 5732 hours of slack to collect. You are set up to collect it yourselves.

Can you take it? If you can, tell us the time you can collect and a phone number for pickup. If not, a quick no helps us move to the next place.

Thank you,
[Coordinator name]
